communityCenter.title: Deliver owned items to the Community Center
communityCenter.reason: The Community Center still has unfinished bundles, and your inventory contains matching items. Delivering them while nearby advances the route.
communityCenter.uncertainty: Completed bundles are filtered using save bundle completion flags; exact requirements still use the built-in vanilla bundle catalog.

seasonEnd.title: Don't plant season-locked crops near the end of the season
seasonEnd.reason: In the last 4 days of a season, avoid planting single-season crops that cannot mature before the season changes.
seasonEnd.uncertainty: This reminder only uses the plan date; if you have already planted or advanced the day, use the in-game state.

festival.title: Festival today: {festival}
festival.reason: Today is a festival day, which may affect shops, NPC schedules, and available actions.
festival.uncertainty: Festival participation is up to you, and entering the festival area may affect the day schedule.

birthday.giftReason: Birthday gifts are much more valuable than normal gifts, and your inventory has the best recognized gift currently available.
birthday.giftUncertainty: The app cannot confirm whether you have already gifted today in-game.
birthday.birthdayReason: Birthday gifts are much more valuable than normal gifts, but no supported gift was recognized in your inventory.
birthday.birthdayUncertainty: The app cannot confirm whether you have already gifted today in-game.

plant.title: Plant {crop}
plant.reasonWithDays: {crop} takes {days} days to mature and can still finish before the season ends if planted today.
plant.reasonWithoutDays: {crop} can still mature before the season ends if planted today.

mine.reason: Progressing in the Mines unlocks deeper resources and can also provide ore, gems, and combat experience.

joja.reasonWithGold: You are {gold}g short of the next Joja project. Prioritize reliable income today.
joja.reasonEnoughGold: You have enough gold to buy {project}. Visit the Joja Community Development Form to advance the route.
